conditions: The exporter marks the variable or field with a minus in its declaration. The import-side restriction is evaluated in a module that imports the declaring module.
limitations: The described restrictions concern importer access and the stated array and record designators. Pointer reachability and deep immutability require separate evidence.

triggers: Reassess an edition or source correction, changed evidence bytes, new contrary designer evidence, or change to the base Oberon identity.

statement: The Oberon-2 report describes a minus export mark that gives importing modules read-only access to marked variables and record fields. Selecting an element of a read-only array or a field of a read-only record also yields a read-only designator.
